I have farmed these 10.1 mu for 40 years. I am 76 now and I only finished primary school, but I know every corner of my fields. I learned from my father and from watching my neighbors. What works, I keep doing. What fails, I never touch again.

This year I will manage my crops the same way I did last year, because last year was decent and change is dangerous when you have seven people to feed.

For the winter wheat, I sow about 25 jin of improved seed per mu — the kind I buy from the dealer in town, the same one my neighbor Old Wang uses. Before sowing, I spread one 50kg bag of compound fertilizer on each mu. Then in the spring, when the wheat turns green and starts growing fast, I top-dress with 30kg of urea per mu. I used to put less urea, but three years ago Old Wang cut back and his wheat went yellow and thin. I would rather spend the extra 40 yuan per mu than lose yield. I irrigate four times from my well: once before the ground freezes for winter, once at jointing when the stems shoot up, once at heading, and once when the grain is filling. I spray pesticide twice — herbicide right after sowing, and another time in spring if I see aphids or rust. I run the rotary tiller before I sow. Last year I got about 450kg per mu. This year I expect 480kg per mu if the weather holds.

For the summer maize, right after we cut the wheat in June, I rotary till and sow hybrid corn seed. I put about 5 jin of seed per mu. At sowing I lay down one 50kg bag of compound fertilizer per mu, and when the corn reaches the big trumpet stage, I spread 25kg of urea per mu. I irrigate three times: after sowing if the soil is dry, at the big trumpet stage, and when the grain fills. Two pesticide sprays: one for weeds early, one later for corn borer if I see moths flying in the evening. I expect about 550kg per mu.

Fertilizer costs me over 200 yuan per mu for each crop. That is a lot of money. But I have learned that saving on fertilizer is a false economy. My nephew tried to cut his fertilizer by one-third two years ago and his maize dropped by more than 100kg per mu. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting a little fertilizer is just a cost. I watch what the people around me do. We all apply about the same amounts. At my age, I do not experiment.
